infer_monte_carlo_samples: run MCMC inference with SingleSiteAncestralMetropolisHastings to get MonteCarloSamples for random variables
get_chain_from_samples: extract a single chain from MonteCarloSamples using get_chain with a valid chain index
get_variable_with_adaptive_steps: retrieve variable samples from MonteCarloSamples including or excluding adaptive warmup steps
get_log_likelihoods: get log likelihood values for observed variables from MonteCarloSamples with optional adaptive steps
convert_samples_to_inference_data: convert MonteCarloSamples to an ArviZ InferenceData object with optional warmup posterior groups
